groove.texte: In his methods, Gabriel has you sing before you play: "Koum" for the bass drum, "Ka" for the snare. Light up some steps, start the loop, set the tempo. Snare hits off beats 2 and 4 sound as ghost notes.
groove.son: Sound only starts when you start the groove.

travailler.t1: Count and sing the phrase out loud, with the metronome on the off-beat.
travailler.t2: Voice, hands and feet answer each other, then swap: that's the switch.
travailler.t3: The sticking worked on the pad moves to the kit and becomes a groove: "Koum" on the bass drum, "Ka" on the snare.
travailler.alt: A practice pad, drumsticks and a metronome on a wooden table

themes.texte: Each clinic builds on the Le Rythme Intérieur and From Pad To Groove methods.
themes.x1: Sharpen your sense of improvisation and find new ideas.
themes.x2: Improve your groove by working on your sound, all the way to a personal sound.
themes.x3: Organise your sessions and save time while learning.

organiser.texte: Stores, festivals and schools write to Gabriel directly. For a masterclass, Sonor's artist manager can also be contacted.
